verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs describe a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and lets you action policies, risks and evidence. They also cover pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection, AI-based evidence gap checks before audit, and working with your auditor in-platform. That covers the core of running a SOC 2 program, but the evidence never separates Type I from Type II, never names the Trust Services Criteria, and gives no detail on the required policy templates. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II support, Trust Services Criteria control mapping, detail on required policy templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end SOC 2 audit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Step‑by‑step, CTA‑driven guide to complete Sprinto’s SOC 2 Launchpad, generate your blueprint, and action policies, risks, and evidence.
Fast-track audits: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
Audit readiness by design: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
Assign tasks, set deadlines, and work cross-functionally with your team and auditor in-platform.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
